# Avocate Harvest Escrow

> USDC escrow on the Stellar network for agricultural trade between a buyer and a farmer. The buyer locks the price in a per-trade smart contract, an independent validator checks the delivery, and the farmer is paid in seconds once it is confirmed. A financing pool funded by several depositors can advance up to 80% of the price to onboarded farmers. Beta on Stellar testnet with test USDC: no real money.

Built by Avocate (https://avocate.io) during HackMeridian 2026 in Lisbon. Version 0.0.5.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/): what the product does, how a trade runs, the anti-fraud rules and a FAQ.
- [Overview](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/overview): live network status, contract addresses and current fees.
- [Buyer](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/buyer): create a trade, deposit the price, confirm delivery or take a refund.
- [Farmer](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/farmer): follow your trades and request an advance co-signed with the buyer.
- [Pool](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/pool): deposit into the financing pool, see its value, share price and open advances.
- [Validator](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/validator): record whether a delivery conforms.
- [Agent](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/agent): settle a validated trade on the buyer's behalf.
- [Admin](https://avocate-harvest-escrow.vercel.app/admin): fees for new trades, farmer onboarding and the registry of all trades.

## Key facts

- Fees: the buyer pays 1% of the price on top, refunded if the trade is refunded. On an advance, the farmer pays 2% to the pool's depositors and 0.5% to Avocate. Each trade keeps the fees it was created with.
- A rejected delivery refunds the buyer in full and the pool's depositors share any advance loss. A financed trade that lapses at its deadline repays the pool first.
- Contracts: Soroban (Rust). The financing pool follows the SEP-56 tokenized vault standard.
